title: The Last Croissant
intro: Monday, 9:04. The last croissant in the break room is gone. Three colleagues were on the floor. You get 12 questions.
solution: Bruno took it just before nine. Ada's warm mug put her in the break room, where she saw him hovering by the box.

crumbs.name: Crumbs
crumbs.text: A trail of crumbs leads from the break room to the open space.

mug.name: Warm mug
mug.text: Ada's mug sat by the coffee machine this morning, still warm.

bruno_seen.name: Ada's statement
bruno_seen.text: At 8:50 Ada saw Bruno hovering by the pastry box.

confession.name: Confession
confession.text: Bruno admits he took the croissant.

ada.name: Ada
ada.role: the developer who always arrives first
ada.dodge: I have a build to fix. Ask me something that matters.

morning.about: where she was and what she did this morning
morning.says: I was at my desk from 8:30, fixing a build. I never went to the break room.

cracks.says: Fine. I went in for coffee at 8:50. The croissant was still there, and Bruno was hovering by the box.

morning.label: Their morning

others.about: what she saw or thinks of her colleagues
others.says: Chloe was on a call with her door shut all morning. You could hear her through the wall.
others.label: The others
others.sample: What did you see of the others?

bruno.name: Bruno
bruno.role: the sales lead who skips breakfast
bruno.voice: Too friendly, talks around the question.
bruno.dodge: Ha, good one. Anything else I can help with?

morning.about: where he was and what he did this morning
morning.says: I came in at nine sharp and went straight to my desk. Ask anyone.

cracks.says: All right, I took it. I skipped breakfast and it was just sitting there.

morning.label: Their morning

food.says: Me? I'm off pastries this month. Doctor's orders.
food.label: Breakfast

others.about: what he saw or thinks of his colleagues
others.says: Ada's mug was by the coffee machine this morning, still warm. She was in there before me.
others.label: The others
others.sample: What did you see of the others?

chloe.name: Chloe
chloe.dodge: Sorry, I have a call in two minutes. Is this important?

morning.about: where she was and what she did this morning
morning.says: I've been on calls since 8:15. I haven't left this room.
morning.label: Their morning

others.about: what she saw, heard or thinks of her colleagues
others.says: I heard the break room door twice before nine. That's all I know.
others.label: The others
others.sample: What did you see of the others?

door.label: The door
door.sample: Which door did you hear twice?
door.says: It was the break room door. It squeaks.
